variants.B0: Unperturbed frozen input semantics; also supplies B1/C/D expectations by key selection.

status_definitions.calculated: All required source, activity, parameter and formula conditions for this source-pollutant item are satisfied; numeric zero remains a valid number.
status_definitions.information_insufficient: A required calculation fact or parameter is absent or unmappable; generation and emission must be blank.
status_definitions.source_data_invalid: A source relation or hard numeric constraint is invalid; generation and emission must be blank.
status_definitions.not_involved: The fuel or process item is demonstrably outside this fossil fixed-combustion calculation; generation and emission must be blank.

method_modes.empirical_zero: Reviewed explicit zero path, not a T/CSES combustion factor.

units.activity_record.value: kg for mass fuels or m3 for gaseous fuels

field_semantics.evaluation_item_id: Public source/component/pollutant ID, stable across B0/B1/C/D and independent of Full internal rule IDs.
field_semantics.expected_native_parameter_ids: Native frozen-rule IDs retained for Full trace audit only; never used as a cross-method correctness key.
field_semantics.parameter_evaluation_ids: Public hashes of method category, parameter role, value, unit and normalized standard reference; compared as a multiset.
field_semantics.applicability_mask: Per-state scoring mask for status, activity, method, parameter, control, value, exception, minimum recalculation and trace.
field_semantics.expected_reason_codes: Sorted JSON array; may include nonblocking notices on calculated items.
field_semantics.expected_value_applicable: True only when both expected_generation_t and expected_emission_t must be numeric.
field_semantics.reference_basis: High-level origin of the expected decision; detailed citations remain in expected_standard_reference.
